_note:
Labelled set for scripts/eval-matcher.js. One profile, ten postings, each with the flags a correct matcher should raise and the band its two scores should land in. `recorded` is a model answer captured once and committed, so the offline run is deterministic and measures THIS repository's flag handling, span finding and ranking rather than today's weather at DeepSeek. Re-record with --live when the prompt changes.

Every case carries `set`. The holdout is never tuned on and is the only honest input to a final comparison; the tune set is where work happens. The two holdout cases were chosen mechanically, not by taste: they are the only pair that can be removed while leaving all ten flag codes still represented in tune (shape survives in shape-frontend, sen_hi and cred in sen-hi-principal). With n=10 a holdout of 2 quantises every metric to halves, so treat it as a smoke test that the tune set has not been overfitted -- not as a measurement. It becomes one when the set grows.
